predictiveDistribution: full discrete empirical law of signed earlier calibration residuals around each predicted increment; exact CRPS; no Gaussian shape or unobserved tail extrapolation
status: retrospective observation-archive experiment; report clocks are not historical receipt clocks; no live skill or trade admission
